title: Losing Bats Threatens $53 Billion in Free Farm Protection
hook: Bat collapse threatens $53 billion in free pest control.
closing: Losing bats means more crop pests and higher food costs for everyone.
question: Have you seen bats nearby?

segments.say: The fungus reached 35 states, turning one cave outbreak into a national threat.
Northern long-eared bats declined 97 percent, leaving almost none of a once-common species.
Bat pest control is worth 53 billion dollars yearly, so their disappearance carries a real price.
